name: quota-text
description: Show remaining Codex quota and reset time as small text on Windows.

interface.longDescription: A third-party Windows desktop companion that displays remaining Codex / Work quota and reset time as small text. No dashboard or taskbar icon. Requires a signed-in desktop client and its local Codex and Node.js runtimes. This beta has only been tested on Windows 11 at 125% display scaling. It does not show all model-specific ChatGPT message limits.

publication.release_notes: Initial Windows-only beta with a small text overlay, opt-in logon startup, and local status tools.

zh-CN.subtitle: 左下角看剩余额度
zh-CN.description: 只显示剩余百分比、重置日期和时间。不占任务栏，不打开看板。需要已登录的 Windows 桌面客户端及其本地运行时。当前为测试版，仅验证过 Windows 11 和 125% 缩放。
